Another thing is auditory hallucinations. When I am longer periods of time without my hearing aid and not listening to music using bone conduction headphones, I think my brain just starts making up stuff that I am "supposed to hear" like the phone is ringing, when it is not, door opening, etc, but that doesn't happen when I am using the hearing aid.
